name: T. W. Ingersoll
bio: T. W. Ingersoll, a St. Paul photographer, stayed in Medora about ten days in September 1885, hunting and taking many photographic views of the Bad Lands. He later wrote that the views were turning out well and that ordered prints would be delivered through the Cow Boy office.

moments.label: Stopped in Medora on a photographing trip
Reported success with his Bad Lands views

mentions: W. T. Ingersoll, the best photographer in St. Paul went through Medora with the St. Paul jobbers, on his way to the National Park. He will remain there about five weeks and on his retur…
T. W. Ingersoll, one of the best photographers in the Northwest, stopped off at Medora this morning on a business and pleasure trip. He will stay some time, provided he gets enough work…
T. W. Ingersoll, after ten days' stay, in which he took not only a hunt, but a large number of photographic views, left Sunday morning for St. Paul.
We have received word from Mr. Ingersoll that he is having splendid success with his Bad Lands views. Those already ordered will be at the Cow Boy office for delivery in about three weeks.
